compare_runs.title: Compare runs
compare_runs.question: Given two runs and a parameter, are the differences the product reports the right ones?

analyst_questions.title: Analyst questions
analyst_questions.question: Does the product state the answer to the questions an engineer asks of a run: a value at a time, the peak and when, an average over a window, when a threshold was crossed, how much it changed?

fair_comparison.title: Fair comparison
fair_comparison.question: When batches of different product or scale are compared, does the product say so, and does it avoid calling unrecorded context the same?

gaps.title: Missing results
gaps.question: Against what the site requires for every batch, does the product report exactly the results that are missing?

trace_usage.title: Trace a lot through batches
trace_usage.question: Given a raw-material lot, does the product return exactly the batches recorded as using it, and say when the genealogy is incomplete?

find_identifier.title: Find a record by lot number
find_identifier.question: Given a lot number as a firm wrote it, does search return the reports that name it?

trace_mention.title: Link records by lot number
trace_mention.question: Given the same lot number, does tracing return the reports that mention it, as mentions?

intent_abstention.title: Decide or abstain (decision model)
intent_abstention.question: Asked which of 20 intents a real request means, does the decision model pick the right one, say "unknown" for a request that fits none, and is its probability a usable signal?

detect_deviation.title: Catch a deviation
detect_deviation.question: Replaying a real run with a labelled anomaly through the product's own check, is a signal raised during the anomaly, and not before it?
detect_deviation.capability: deviation signals: specification limits and trend rules

point_at_change.title: Point at the change
point_at_change.question: Of the largest changes the Trends page lists for a series, does one fall inside the labelled anomaly, and can it say when a run is unremarkable?

rank_causes.title: Rank possible causes
rank_causes.question: Asked what might have caused a labelled anomaly, is the action that actually caused it among the first candidates?

datasets.title: CLINC150 intent data with out-of-scope queries
datasets.kind: Real crowd-written requests to an assistant in 150 intents, plus requests that fit none of them. General assistant domains, not manufacturing.

most_common_failures.reason: said unknown for a request that fits an intent
chose an intent for a request that fits none

decision_model.reading: observed_rate is how often answers in that probability band were right. If the probability were calibrated, the observed rate would sit inside the band.

limits: Public data from laboratories, one manufacturer and regulators; not your sites.
The data was loaded directly as deliveries in review. Reading messy files is measured elsewhere.
Specifications and readable names were added where the report says so; nothing else was.
Host-arm cases use no model. They say nothing about the assistant.
